notes: Transcriber layout note: the printed box has no column headings. Parameter and Value are editorial column labels; every printed string is retained unchanged in the cells.

Printed immediately below the boxed table and still part of this item (the caption's 'actual achieved' figures): 'Average of past two years', 'Bio-gas Generated  3200 m³/day', 'Electrical Energy Generated  6600 kWh'. They are outside the printed border and carry no row rule.
Printed units are inconsistent inside one table: Bio-Gas Yield in Ncum/kg VS destroyed, Bio-Gas Generated in m³/day, Calorific Value in kWh/cum. Retained as printed; not normalized.
Numbers are printed without thousands separators (10890, 6480, 3150, 2677.5, 9157.5, 3777, 7931, 7850) and are retained exactly.
